versions.changelog: Multi-language extended (6 bahasa), auto char limit, email sequence, SEO meta, industry templates, bulk mode
Update README and CHANGELOG for v1.6.0 features

Copyku 1.6.0 brings multi-language support, new message platforms, A/B copy testing, and enhanced compliance.

- Menambahkan dukungan multi-language (Indonesia & English)
- Integrasi template platform baru: WhatsApp, SMS, dan Telegram
- Menambah pilihan tone hingga 30 (termasuk B2B, seasonal, formal, dll.)
- Fitur Copyku Lab: A/B testing dengan 2-3 variasi copy sekaligus
- Advanced fields: context kompetitor, value proposition, jaminan/garansi, compliance notes, dan output format (plain/markdown/html)
- Guardrails etika dan compliance lebih kuat

- Documentation update only: revised README.md for clarity and usage instructions.
- No changes to code or user-facing features in this release.

Copyku 1.5.0 introduces a new multi-mode workflow for easier, faster, and more precise copy generation.

- Tambah 3 mode kerja: Quick Copy (cepat), Guided (step-by-step), dan Advanced (kontrol penuh).
- Input & output dibuat lebih praktis dan lebih mudah dipahami semua user.
- Otomatisasi deteksi kebutuhan dan platform untuk pemilihan formula dan tone copy paling relevan.
- Panduan request cepat & contoh penggunaan untuk berbagai kebutuhan copywriting.
- Penjelasan dan selektor tone diperbarui untuk pemilihan gaya bahasa.
- Struktur output lebih jelas & terstandarisasi di seluruh platform.

- Added extensive input options to the input format, allowing more detailed and customizable copy requests (industry, price_range, competitor, usp, pain_point, benefit, objection, cta_type, length, language_style, emoji_level, include_testimoni, include_guarantee, season, channel, brand_voice, include_hashtag, age_range, gender, location).
- Updated input format section to clarify minimal and full input possibilities.
- No changes to core copywriting engine, workflow, features, or ethical guidelines.

**Streamlined documentation, clearer workflows, and updated feature list.**

- Documentation fully disederhanakan dan dibuat lebih ringkas.
- Penggunaan dan format input lebih jelas di bagian Quick Start.
- Struktur copywriting, awareness model, persuasif layer, dan mode tone dirangkum menjadi tabel agar mudah dipilih.
- Daftar fitur, platform output, dan penjelasan workflow makin sistematis dan user-friendly.
- Penambahan dan perbaikan pada bagian Ethical Guardrails & Knowledge References untuk transparansi metode.

copyku 1.2.0

- Added: Comprehensive tone & style table with 23 detailed modes for various copywriting needs.
- Expanded tone/style options section, offering more guidance and clarity for users.
- Documentation improvements with clearer explanations and more usage examples.
- Introduced CHANGELOG.md file for future tracking of updates.

Version 1.1.0 – Major Update

- Menambahkan basis pengetahuan dari copywriting global (Bly, Ogilvy, Schwartz, Cialdini, dsb).
- Perluasan struktur copy dengan awareness model & persuasion layers.
- Mendukung lebih banyak format: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, Landing/Sales Page, Email, hingga WhatsApp.
- Penambahan analisa sebelum penulisan: level awareness, emotional driver, headline & CTA variation, dan hook testing.
- Update pilihan tone & style, serta penyaringan etis lebih ketat.
- Penjelasan input/output dan keyword aktivasi lebih rinci.

Initial release of Copyku, a Bahasa Indonesia copywriting expert for digital marketing needs.

- Generates persuasive, strategic, and conversion-oriented copy for social media, ads, landing pages, and email.
- Supports multiple copywriting formulas (AIDA, PAS, 4U, BAB).
- Provides various output templates for common digital platforms.
- Includes clarification logic to optimize results based on user input.
- Safety constraints to prevent misleading, harmful, or illegal content.
